'''Tark''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When several individuals had valuable knowledge with regard to political allegiances in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], Tark sent an Imperial spacer to free those individuals from the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Kal Bedo]], who was holding them hostage.
